summary.text: Adam Botana represents Florida House District 80; Botana was elected to the Florida House in 2020 and reelected subsequently.

paragraphs.text: According to the House's biography, Botana lives in Bonita Springs, was born in Naples, Florida, and lists marina industry small business owner among occupations.
Botana served as Majority Chief Floor Whip from 2022 to 2024.
